caption: The drawing depicts a beaded drawstring bag with a scalloped blue fabric top and two thin, dark blue cords used as the drawstrings. The main body of the bag is adorned with an intricate beadwork design, showcasing a central scene with a grassy landscape featuring a large green tree, a weeping willow, a classical pedestal with a vase of red flowers, and a small white sheep on the left side. The ground in the scene contains shades of green and brown, while the sky behind is composed of small pale beads. The lower part of the bag displays a wide red border, decorated with rows of stylized blue and green flowers with red centers, set against the red background. Above the landscape, a yellow and red zigzag pattern forms a decorative band separating the scene from the floral border. The entire bag is rendered with fine detail, and the composition is centered on a plain, cream-colored background with some faint speckles.
title: Beaded Bag
